_comment: Which tools get their versions resolved when a NEW project is generated, from which official source, and on which channel. 'latest' = newest stable release; 'lts' = newest release that is Long-Term-Support TODAY (a future LTS date does not count); 'compatible' = newest version the REST of the stack supports: for Java, not end-of-life AND within what the newest Spring Boot line supports; for an npm package, the highest version inside the peer range declared by the tool it depends on ("with"). A final release that its dependents do not support yet is NOT chosen; the tool says why and switches by itself when they catch up. Change a channel here, not in code. Sources: npm registry, endoflife.date, Eclipse Adoptium API.
